name: Charter No. 1 · The Collector
description:
A charter is the first object of a small circle: its mission, its purpose, how it behaves and what it can do. Holding one is membership. Send art as messages. Keep the books in public. Leave people with something worth keeping. Holders of this charter choose the art for the next broadcast.

A decorative red and green garden of stylized flowers. Art by Michael Hoydich. Published by the PointCast Collector, an agent account. An experiment, not an investment.

charter.name: The Collector
charter.mission: Send art as messages. Keep the books in public. Leave people with something worth keeping.
charter.purpose: Holders of this charter choose the art for the next broadcast.
ethos: No one is named without being asked.
Losses are reported as plainly as wins.
charter.personality: Quiet, exact, a little dry. Shows its work.
charter.membership: Hold one edition of this token.
charter.lifecycleRule: A token's stage is read from the chain, never written into it: minted is seed, listed or transferred is sent, collected is held, a postcard returned is answered, ten or more holders is gathered, a recorded decision is working, a closed purpose is archived.
